## Review of #3558 (head `38eae631e`) - verdict: needs changes before merge

This review read the diff, the touched files at the head, `origin/main`
`AGENTS.md` at PROCESS_VERSION 134, `.github/workflows/post-merge.yml`,
issue #3556 with all comments, and #3470. It built and tested the change in a
local review worktree. It did not start `pr-test.yml`.

### What looks good

- The body has `Process change: yes`, `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #3556`.
  The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
- The text follows the six decision points on #3556. No merge waits for a
  heavy lane run. The owed-heavy rule is retired in `AGENTS.md`, the `gate`,
  `merge-ready` and `review-prs` skills, and `PR-reviewer.md`. The names
  #2568, #3460 and #3467 stay, so their citations resolve.
- The two xtask tests follow the new law. They fail if the old full-lane
  demand or the old owed deferral returns. The `#[test]` count stays 11.
- `docs/decisions/3556-targeted-tests-at-review.md` follows the format of
  `docs/decisions/README.md`.

### Results merged with main

Run locally, in `.claude/worktrees/cc-pr3558-review`, against `origin/main`
`64b7377`:

- Trial merge: `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 38eae631e` gives tree
  `78ccf3836`, exit 0. `git merge --no-ff` is clean.
- Quick plan (`cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run`): 1 step,
  `xtask unit tests` (`cargo test -j 3 -p xtask -- --test-threads=3`).
- Heavy plan (`cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run`): "the
  diff reaches no heavy lane: nothing to run".
- `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask heavy_plan_tests`: 11 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask light_tests`: 6 passed, 0 failed.
- `#[test]` count in `xtask/src/heavy_plan_tests.rs`: 11 on `main`, 11 at the
  head.
- The full `cargo test -p xtask` binary was started and stopped. Its catalog
  tests start a cold `cargo build -p camcraft-app --bin camcraft-cli` in this
  worktree, which passes the 9-minute limit. This is not a finding for this
  PR.
- Clippy is not part of the quick plan for this diff, and the review did not
  run it. The changed test code compiles.

### Heavy lanes

The diff reaches no heavy lane. No heavy run is required for this PR, and
none ran.

### Requested before merge

1. `AGENTS.md:631-632`: "The full heavy steps of the red twins run at the cut,
   and they must pass before the cut gate starts again." The first clause
   follows the decision. The second clause is the old local-rerun sentence,
   and it contradicts the first. The maintainer's comment on #3556
   (2026-11-22, 19:37) says: "They do not run locally before the cut." Change
   the sentence to: "The full heavy steps of the red twins run at the cut, in
   the cut gate." Keep the next sentence, "A local run never replaces the cut
   gate." `AGENTS.md:865` already holds the local full rerun sentence for a
   red cut gate. Do not copy it into the light-lane rule.
2. `docs/decisions/3556-targeted-tests-at-review.md:7-9`: record the
   light-lane decision that the maintainer gave on #3556 at 19:37. A red
   light run is only a note. The full heavy steps of the red twins run in the
   cut gate, and they do not run locally before the cut. The file names the
   light lane in point 1, but it does not record this rule.
3. The PR body: update the "Open" list and the gate line. Commit
   `38eae631e` closes open item 1. The 19:37 comment answers open item 3. The
   gate ran the xtask tests, so "Gate: none; text only" is stale.

### Questions and notes (not blocking)

- **For the coordinator: the post-merge runner does not run the full heavy
  lanes.** The new text says they run "on the post-merge and cut runners" at
  `AGENTS.md:650-651`, `.claude/agents/PR-reviewer.md:148-149`,
  `.claude/skills/gate/SKILL.md:161-162`,
  `.claude/skills/merge-ready/SKILL.md:235-236`,
  `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md:264-265`,
  `.claude/skills/work-issue/SKILL.md:89-90`, and
  `docs/decisions/3556-targeted-tests-at-review.md:12-13,32`. But
  `.github/workflows/post-merge.yml:81-103` runs `cargo xtask gate batch`.
  The batch tier has "No release-mode heavy lanes" (`gate/SKILL.md:23`), and
  `AGENTS.md:754-755` and `AGENTS.md:811-812` say that post-merge runs the
  batch tier. The decision words on #3556 repeat the post-merge claim, so
  this is for the coordinator and the maintainer to settle. It is not a
  change for the contributor alone.
- `xtask/src/heavy_plan_tests.rs:131`: the test name
  `runner_review_requires_heavy_lanes_without_author_results` now pins the
  opposite of its name. A rename makes the pin easier to read. The review
  also removed the assertion on "and 4, then continue at step 5.", which
  pinned the runner path into step 5. Suggest a pin for that routing in the
  same follow-up.
- `gate test --crate xtask` selects nothing, as the body says. The quick
  plan still selects the touched binary as `xtask unit tests`. A worker can
  run `cargo xtask gate quick --only "xtask unit tests"`.
- The new review law asks for the light lane for every PR. This review did
  not run it, because the diff changes no product code. The coordinator may
  want an explicit exemption for a docs or process PR.
- `docs/decisions/3556-targeted-tests-at-review.md:7-9` has one long
  sentence (about 38 words). Two shorter sentences are easier to read in
  ASD-STE100.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

## Review of #3558 (head `c2dd094e9`) - verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge

This review read the delta from `38eae631e`, the touched files at the head,
`.github/workflows/post-merge.yml`, `.github/workflows/cut.yml` and the
decision files. It built and tested the change locally in
`.claude/worktrees/cc-pr3558-review`, against `origin/main` `64b737729`. It
did not start `pr-test.yml`: the PR changes `xtask/`, and the workflow
refuses that file.

### What looks good

- The fix answers the three items of the review at `38eae631e`:
  - `AGENTS.md` "The light lane" now says the full heavy steps of the red
    twins "run at the cut, in the cut gate". It drops the local rerun
    clause. It keeps the sentence "A local run never replaces the cut gate."
  - `docs/decisions/3556-targeted-tests-at-review.md:10-12` records the
    light-lane rule from #3556 (19:37). A red light run is only a note. The
    full heavy steps of the red twins run in the cut gate. They do not run
    locally before the cut.
  - The PR body closes Open item 1, answers item 3, and the Gate line gives
    the readings.
- The runner text is now correct. Seven process files name the cut gate on
  the cut runner, not the post-merge runner. `.github/workflows/post-merge.yml:103`
  runs `cargo xtask gate batch`, and the batch tier has no release-mode
  heavy lanes (`gate/SKILL.md:23`). `.github/workflows/cut.yml:65,104` runs
  `cargo xtask gate release` on `[self-hosted, camcraft-cut]`. No workflow
  file changed.
- The pin `review_requires_targeted_heavy_tests_on_both_paths` pins the
  runner routing into step 5. The reverse check fails as the body claims.
- The earlier passes stay true. The body has `Process change: yes`, and the
  PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The retired heavy demand is
  gone from every touched process file, and the xtask tests pin its
  absence. `docs/decisions/3556-targeted-tests-at-review.md` follows the
  format of `docs/decisions/README.md`. The changed sentences are short
  (ASD-STE100).

### Results merged with main

Run locally in `.claude/worktrees/cc-pr3558-review`, with
`CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=3`, against `origin/main` `64b737729`:

- Trial merge: `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main c2dd094e9` gives
  tree `cb5b798e8`, exit 0. `git merge --no-ff` is clean.
- Quick plan (`cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run`): 9
  files changed; 1 step, `xtask unit tests`.
- Heavy plan (`cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run`):
  "the diff reaches no heavy lane: nothing to run".
- `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask heavy_plan_tests`: 11 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask light_tests`: 6 passed, 0 failed.
- `#[test]` count in `xtask/src/heavy_plan_tests.rs`: 11 at `origin/main`,
  11 at the head.
- Reverse check: with the old line "The heavy check is required on both
  paths." restored, the renamed pin fails at
  `xtask/src/heavy_plan_tests.rs:141` ("a runner verdict must still reach
  the common heavy check"). The worktree file was restored after the check.
- The full `xtask unit tests` binary was not run. Its catalog tests start a
  cold `cargo build -p camcraft-cli` and pass the time box. The two touched
  test modules ran.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` fails on
  `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67` (`needless_bool`). That file is identical to
  `origin/main`, and the PR does not touch it. This is a pre-existing
  failure on main, not a finding for this PR.

### Heavy lanes

The diff reaches no heavy lane. No heavy run is required for this PR, and
none ran.

### Requested before merge

None. The three items of the review at `38eae631e` are fixed.

### Questions and notes (not blocking)

- `xtask/src/unit_sweep.rs:67` has a pre-existing `needless_bool` clippy
  error on `main`. A follow-up issue is reasonable. It does not block this
  PR.
- `an_owed_heavy_result_is_allowed_for_p3_and_lower_only` keeps a name that
  describes the retired rule. The body and the test comment explain the
  name, so it is readable.
- The decision file names the maintainer's post-merge words and the reason
  for the correction. That is good provenance.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
